Name: Friendships Affect Prices
Author: weissnicht01
Description:
Do you think friends should give each other a discount? Then this mod is for you!

_____________

If you have enough hearts with a villiager, they will give you a discount at their stores.
[b]The level of discount and required hearts can be changed in the config file or via the the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu. [/url][/b]
By default:
10% discount at 3 hearts
25% discount at 6 hearts
50% discount at 10 hearts

Note: "Required Friendship Lvl" lists the level, not the hearts. 250 points constitute one heart. You can only change this setting in steps of 250.


_____________

[u]Affected:
[/u]
[b]Shops:[/b]
All normal vanilla shops
All of Pierre's festival booths
All shops from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Villiage[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley[/url]
The Adventurer's Guild Shop if Marlon is present and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] is installed.
The Hat Mouse Shop if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Hat Mouse Lacey[/url] is installed.
JojaMart if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] and enable that option (disabled by default)
-> Even if other mods add extra items/options to them

[b]Other: [/b]
Farm buildings from Robin and the Wizard
All home renovations
Pet adoptions
Vanilla farm animals
Ostriches and Dinosaurs if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22008]Buyable Dinosaurs and Ostriches[/url] installed
Farm animals added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28303]Jonbow's Animals[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021]Dwarven Expansion[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28347]AzureDragon's Tame Rocks[/url]
Farm buildings added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28303]Jonbow's Animals[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021]Dwarven Expansion[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23284?]Buildable Camper[/url]
The Item Recovery System if Marlon is present and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7018]Make Marlon Real[/url] is installed.

Not affected:
House upgrades (not sure how to change those)
Backpacks (not sure how to change those either)
Shops whose owners cannot be befriended
Shops, animals and buildings added by mods other than the ones listed above


[b]I will (pending aproval) add patches for more mods that add shops, animals and buildings. Let me know which mods you want to see covered.[/b]

_____________

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Requires game version 1.6
Compatible mods are not required. Changes for those are only made if they are installed.
